scope: Original 2020 Dune: Imperium base/core standard 2–4-player multiplayer, including required two-player House Hagal. Solo-only PDF p. 20 and expansion/promo/Uprising FAQ clauses were read for scope separation and excluded from gameplay evaluation. Catalog identifiers and historical verification metadata are not gameplay claims.

checked_claims.claim: Deck-building, worker placement, four Factions, VP objective, round-end threshold, leader abilities and card overrides; original core multiplayer scope.
Component quantities, player components and identical ten-card starting deck.
source_references: Rulebook p. 3, visual component list; extracted lines 99–152; p. 2 two Leaders per Great House

checked_claims.claim: Mentat and Alliance placement, separately shuffled 1/5/4 Conflict deck and unused-card destination, Intrigue/Imperium/Reserve areas.

checked_claims.claim: Leader choice and complexity, Agent and Swordmaster placement, personal decks, player-count VP start, Combat markers, cubes and garrisons, water, bank, random first player.

checked_claims.claim: Five ordered phases, Conflict reveal and five-card draw, clockwise alternating Agent/Reveal turns, optional early Reveal and subsequent skipped turns; Plot timing.
source_references: Rulebook p. 8; extracted lines 325–360

checked_claims.claim: One card/one matching icon/one Agent to unoccupied space; entry costs before effects, then space/card/Influence effects in any order.
source_references: Rulebook p. 9; extracted lines 373–436

checked_claims.claim: Arrow effects optional and once per effect, board entry costs compulsory, Intrigue conditions/costs compulsory; mandatory effects with stated exceptions and trashing rules.

checked_claims.claim: Recruit supply to garrison; supply limitation; Combat-space deployment of current-turn recruits from all sources plus at most two earlier garrison troops.

checked_claims.claim: Four ordered Reveal steps; only newly revealed boxes, flexible effect/acquisition order, strength setting and cleanup into discard.
source_references: Rulebook p. 11; extracted lines 540–599

checked_claims.claim: Cards drawn during Reveal are immediately revealed and used; cards drawn after it remain for next round with five more. Refocus reshuffles deck if discard empty.

checked_claims.claim: Two strength per deployed troop, one per revealed sword, zero without troops, Combat marker +20 convention.

checked_claims.claim: Combat Intrigue clockwise opportunity, passing may be reconsidered, consecutive passes resolve Combat, strength changes, post-win triggers.

checked_claims.claim: Rank rewards, third place only in four-player game, no reward at zero, first/second/third tie rules, no win trigger on tie, newly won trigger card playable; cleanup to supply.
